ReportRelation.ReportRelationExpression: inner join vwdb_Item on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.ItemID = vwdb_Item.ItemID
inner join vwdb_Supplier on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.SupplierID = vwdb_Supplier.SupplierID
inner join vwdb_PaymentTerm on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.PaymentTermID = vwdb_PaymentTerm.PaymentTermID
inner join vwdb_Users on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.RequesterID = vwdb_Users.UserID

ReportFields.ReportFieldName: ( SELECT FlagValue FROM tblCompanyFlag AS tbl WHERE FlagName = 'IsHeaderAndFooterRequiredOnDCDocumentReports' AND tbl.CompanyID = vwdb_PurchaseOrder.CompanyID )

ParameterSetup.ParameterFilter: vwdb_SalesPerson.SalesPersonID in (select * from Fx_GetSalesPersonIDsbyUser('{UserID}')) And companyid=2
